terra.problem: The identification of Bel and Nebo as gods of Babylon is not stated in this passage and needs a supporting reference.
Saying the people carrying the gods are the ones who feel the load overlooks the weary animal in verse 1 and adds that the people feel it.
The text does not say the gods are still in one piece.
Saying God carries them because He made them adds a reason the text does not give.
The verse says God carries, sustains and delivers those He made; it does not say these are things a maker generally does for what he made.
“Other way around” suggests that they followed the LORD, which this passage does not say.
The text says the people cry out, but it does not say they keep crying out afterward.
God says His purpose will stand and He will accomplish His pleasure. The passage does not say His purpose never shifts or is rewritten.
The passage does not say the call is fast. Marking it as a thought does not establish that detail.
The verse says God is bringing His righteousness near, not that He is holding nothing at all back.
Salvation not being delayed does not mean there will be no waiting at all.
The verse does not specify the length of any wait or say there are no events before salvation.
